title: Children's Health Research Institute(CHRI), Stanford Lucile Packard Children Hospital (LPCH) Protocol on Myotonic Dystrophy
brief_summary: Study to focus on the defining and managing the neuropsychological abnormalities of myotonic dystrophy and to find out if the neuropsychological abnormalities have any correlation with changes seen on Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 20 subjects with Myotonic Dystrophy type 1 aged 8 to 17 years and 20 controls who are healthy volunteers or siblings of affected subjects.

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: 20 subjects with Myotonic Dystrophy type 1 aged 8 to 17 years and 20 controls who are healthy volunteers or siblings of affected subjects.
